description_en: Sets the execution time for an over-the-air update
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center approve-ota-task --app-instance-group-id aig-9ciijz60n4xsv0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id ota-be7jzm29wrrz50000 --ota-type Fota --start-time 2022-08-04T14:36:00+08:00 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApproveOtaTask

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain this value
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the delivery group. You can call [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Wuying Cloud Application
parameters.help_zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。可以调用[ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~)查询无影云应用支持的地域列表
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The OTA upgrade task ID. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain this value.

Each successful call to `ApproveOtaTask` causes the `TaskId` to change. Therefore, before calling this operation again, call `ListAppInstanceGroup` again to obtain the latest `TaskId`
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级任务ID。可调用[ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~)获取。

每次调用`ApproveOtaTask`成功后，都会导致`TaskId`变更。因此，再次调用本接口之前，请重新调用`ListAppInstanceGroup`以获取最新的`TaskId`
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the OTA upgrade task. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级任务的开始时间。按照ISO 8601格式填写
parameters.name: start_time
